### Sources

The daily source program screened five open-reading candidate families: Lit2Go, Alpheios Texts, Perseus Scaife Viewer, StoryWeaver, and Project Runeberg. Lit2Go, Alpheios Texts, and Perseus Scaife Viewer completed source-specific review for the exact bounded capability admitted and shipped through pull request #124 as `Classics & Open Reading Discovery Starter`.

The admitted capability is deliberately first-party link discovery rather than copied catalog/content. Lit2Go's current first-party license places educational, non-commercial, and quantity boundaries on reuse; WebNR therefore does not treat free availability as a blanket redistribution license. Alpheios states a default CC BY-SA 4.0 license for Reader texts unless otherwise noted, but those item-level exceptions are not yet modeled by WebNR's source runtime. Scaife Viewer exposes an open classical-text reading environment, but this audit did not establish one blanket redistribution grant for every displayed edition and translation. The committed source therefore stores first-party destination URLs plus WebNR-authored metadata and does not crawl, poll, proxy, mirror, copy texts or origin metadata, download media, create accounts, or bypass access controls.

StoryWeaver remains deferred despite strong first-party CC BY 4.0 policy evidence because direct reader/open-content requests from the verification environment returned HTTP 402 during this cycle; WebNR does not promote search/cache evidence into a claim of reproducible reader-path availability. Project Runeberg remains deferred for a narrower item-specific audit because its current project notes combine free electronic editions with relaxed copyright caution for some newer material and explicit server-pressure concerns, so a blanket machine-ingestion or rights claim would be unsafe.

A rotating retained-source health sample rechecked Project Gutenberg, Aozora Bunko, and Fimfiction public discovery surfaces; all remained publicly discoverable/reachable in the bounded current-web review. No evidence justified downgrading or removing a maintained source.

The daily target is satisfied: five candidates were screened, three were fully audited for the exact admitted capability, one passing native source integration shipped, and retained-source health was rotated.
